Contradiction! Every way forward fails: going up leaves no safe move afterwards; going left would force the two-exit cells to link up into a loop (or put the numbers out of order). So my guess (left from cell (3,3)) was wrong, so the line must go right.

Contradiction! Every way forward fails: going right, the next move is forced and the line gets stuck at cell (3,6); going down, every way of continuing runs into a dead end within a few moves. So my guess (down from number 1) was wrong, so the line must go left.
Going up would leave both number 4 and cell (1,3) needing the line next, and it can't do both; going left would force the line onto number 4 before its turn. So the line goes down.
Cell (3,3) has only two exits, so the line must pass through it now: it goes right.
